PDF Page Size Changer

Resize every page of a PDF to A4, Letter, Legal, A3, A5 or a custom size — content is scaled proportionally, nothing is cropped.

–
Pages resized
–
New size (pt)

1 pt = 1/72 inch. Content keeps its aspect ratio in Fit mode.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload a PDF file.
  2. Pick a target page size (A4, Letter, Legal, A3, A5 or custom).
  3. Choose Fit (no cropping) or Fill (edge-to-edge).
  4. Click Resize pages, then download the new PDF.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Will my content be cropped?

No — pages are scaled to fit the target size while keeping their aspect ratio (letterboxed). Use the Fill option if you prefer edge-to-edge scaling with cropping.

Does resizing reduce quality?

Vector text and graphics scale perfectly at any size. Scanned/image pages are resampled by your PDF viewer when printed.

Is my PDF uploaded anywhere?

No. Everything is processed in your browser; the PDF never leaves your device.
